0.1.6: Update the game from Settings or the login screen. Downloads can pause and resume, and are verified before Android opens the installer. Includes the LOVE ATTACK instrumental menu soundtrack.
0.1.7: In-app updates with resumable downloads and automatic cleanup after installation. LOVE ATTACK Instrumental now plays in the main menu.
0.1.8: Gameplay shows only equipped cards, hides the team panel when empty, and keeps a single card still. Missions and Unlocks now support smooth touch scrolling. Includes resumable in-app updates and the LOVE ATTACK instrumental menu soundtrack.
0.1.9: New RESCENE Rhythm launcher icon, including adaptive and themed Android icons. Replaces the default Godot artwork.
0.1.10: Combo light pillars now have a transparent background on mobile. Removes the dark rectangular panel while preserving the beams, glow and every-10-combo trigger.
0.1.11: Registration now includes a required agreement checkbox and readable Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy dialogs. Adds the fan-made, nonprofit notice, scam warning and contact winterape25@gmail.com.
0.1.12: Login and registration fields stay visible above the Android keyboard, including confirmation and account recovery. Failed requests preserve entered passwords and show the original error; ordinary passwords with at least 8 characters are accepted.
0.1.13: Cleaner touch gameplay: removes the lower-left instructions and keyboard letters beneath the hit circles. The first-play tutorial now uses touch-only instructions.
0.1.14: All 45 approved LE cards across nine releases, with matching album/single decks, release filters, and updated card artwork in Collection, Profile and gameplay. New sets cost 450 STARL with an initial allocation of 50 per member per release. Existing card upgrades and combined five-card bonuses are preserved.
0.1.15: Featured Scene now previews all nine LE card sets in a rotating slideshow. Tap a set to browse its five cards. Cleaner card shop descriptions.
0.1.16: More forgiving note collection: slightly wider Perfect and Great timing, a 180ms hit window, and more tolerance for finger drift on holds and curves. Server verification matches the updated rules.
0.1.17: Wider gameplay road with proportionally larger notes, catchers, ribbons and effects. The equipped-card panel is smaller and stays clear of the road; touch mapping follows the wider lanes.
0.1.18: Brief vibration when a note is missed, with a saved Miss Vibration toggle in Settings. Simultaneous misses produce one short pulse.
0.1.19: Removes the soundtrack songs BamBamBam, Love Frequency and Higher from the song library and APK audio. The library now contains 29 songs.
0.1.20: Adds quick lilac touch ripples and small sparkles throughout menus and dialogs. Menu touch effects are disabled during song gameplay and follow the Particle Effects setting.
